_description: Seed AFDX frames for mutation-based fuzzing. Each VL has a valid, conformant frame that serves as a baseline for generating test cases.
_format: Each seed frame contains all necessary parameters for a valid AFDX transmission

vl_1003.description: Standard conformant frame for VL 1003 - ES1 to Switch1

vl_2002.description: Standard conformant frame for VL 2002 - ES2 to Switch1

vl_2003.description: Standard conformant frame for VL 2003 - ES2 to Switch1

vl_3001.description: Standard conformant frame for VL 3001 - ES3 to Switch1

vl_3002.description: Standard conformant frame for VL 3002 - ES3 to Switch1

vl_default.description: Generic seed frame for any VL ID (used for invalid VL testing)
